patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そだてや　ふうふ　から　もらった　ふしぎな　ポケモンのタマゴ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed before a thing, tells you which thing it is. そだてや　ふうふ　から　もらった　タマゴ = 'the Egg that was received from the Day Care couple'.
